old_problem: A top-level Test #22 pass cannot prove which physical ConnectX/BlueField lanes were scanned, whether every required lane was covered, or whether measurements used the required generation and equalization state. Method, physical mapping, limits and permitted link impact were unbound.
disposition_reason: The row clearly targets ConnectX PCIe eye margin through NVQual Test #22. The exact endpoint/path/lane mapping, vendor scan semantics and generation-specific per-lane limits are Project Configuration. A closed execution gate plus signed inputs resolves the review while ED-15 prevents any PASS without authoritative limits.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2141, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2142 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00019-V002 / 45b61e8fed2ad149 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the licensed pinned Test #22 module, ConnectX/BlueField serial/port/BDF and full root-port/switch/retimer/physical-lane map.
Pin negotiated generation/width, equalization/preset context, scan axes, units, sampling and signed per-lane horizontal/vertical limits; never infer vendor measurement semantics.

Drain dependent traffic, preserve/hash link/AER/NIC/platform baselines, and retain complete untruncated raw results for every required physical lane with timestamps and deterministic threshold comparison.
Link-up, BER, throughput or a top-level vendor pass cannot replace physical-lane eye-margin coverage; an unexpected retrain ends comparability.
Stop on missing/out-of-limit lane, link loss/downtraining, unexpected retrain, AER burst, NIC disappearance, traffic impact, thermal/power fault, hang/reboot or evidence gap; no automatic retry.
No NVQual/eye scan, NIC/link query, traffic drain, log clearing, retrain/reset, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Physical-lane-bound ConnectX/BlueField NVQual Test #22 PCIe eye margin
test_case.purpose: Measure raw horizontal and vertical eye margin on every in-scope physical lane of the exact ConnectX/BlueField endpoint and prove each meets signed generation-specific limits without downtraining, new errors, traffic impact, hang or reboot.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #22 and compatible ConnectX/BlueField firmware/driver
Signed NIC/DPU serial/port/BDF plus root-port/switch/retimer/physical-lane map
Approved generation/width/equalization/preset context and vendor scan axes/units/sampling
Signed per-lane horizontal/vertical limits and link/AER/NIC/platform acceptance
Dedicated drained SUT, trusted access, permitted link-impact scope, abort and vendor recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and per-lane limits are signed. Preserve/hash negotiated-link, AER, NIC and platform baselines and drain the authorized traffic scope. Run only the pinned Test #22 scan on the bound endpoint/path; retain complete raw horizontal/vertical values for every physical lane with generation/equalization context and threshold comparison. Stop on first discrepancy or retrain; do not reset or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every required physical lane is measured in the signed context and meets its approved horizontal/vertical limit; endpoint identity and required generation/width remain stable, traffic resumes only as authorized, and no unexpected retrain, AER/NIC/platform fault, hang or reboot occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without exact module, physical mapping, scan semantics and signed per-lane limits. PASS requires complete accepted raw evidence for every lane and clean correlated health. FAIL on unmeasured/wrong lane, threshold miss, retrain/downtraining, endpoint mismatch/loss, traffic impact, AER/NIC/platform fault, hang/reboot or failed recovery. Missing inputs/artifacts are BLOCKED; aggregate pass is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until Test #22, endpoint/path/lane map, generation/equalization method, limits, traffic impact and recovery are signed.
Verify physical identity and drain dependent traffic before any scan that may retrain the link.
Preserve original negotiated-link/error evidence and use an isolated SUT with console and thermal/power monitoring.
Stop without equalization change, reset or automatic retry on first retrain or anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #22 module/license/configuration and authorization
NIC/DPU serial/port/BDF plus root-port/switch/retimer/physical-lane and generation/width/equalization map
Signed axes/units/sampling/per-lane threshold matrix and permitted retrain/traffic rules
Complete untruncated raw horizontal/vertical measurements and deterministic comparison for every lane
First-fault/vendor recovery or clean final link/traffic state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On missing/out-of-limit lane, unexpected retrain, downtraining, endpoint loss, AER burst, traffic impact or evidence gap, stop and preserve first-fault artifacts. Do not reset or repeat the scan automatically; follow signed vendor recovery and quarantine if the original endpoint/link state is not restored.
